newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech CNB-120 index falls 6.6 points to 905.4.
newsitem.headline: Czech CNB-120 index falls 6.6 points to 905.4.

text.p: The CNB-120 index, a broad daily measure of Czech equities, fell 6.6 points on Tuesday to 905.4, the Czech National Bank (CNB) said.
Five of the ten sectoral indices lost, with the construction index losing most, down 9.6 points to 1,083.1.
Five indices rose, with the investment funds index rising the most, up 15.1 points to 1,096.4.
